remarks: Welcome to 711 Crested Lark, a beautifully upgraded Botanica Plan 3 home in the award-winning community of Rancho Mission Viejo, featuring over $261,000 in builder-selected upgrades. This is a home where the attention to detail really stands out, from the custom wall treatments and hardwood flooring to the designer kitchen and beautifully finished bathrooms. The entry makes an immediate impression with vertical shiplap wainscoting and a shiplap ceiling, while the great room features custom built-in cabinetry and surround sound speakers.
